name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise

instructions.description: Stand or sit tall, holding light dumbbells beside the thighs.
With soft elbows, lift the arms out to the sides.
Stop around shoulder height or earlier if needed.
Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

commentsNotes: Use light loads and avoid shrugging.

variations.variationDescription: Dumbbell Lateral Raise — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Dumbbell Lateral Raise — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
